# agentkit

> The billing framework for Swiss software. Business building blocks for
> Swiss products: subscriptions and shop with Swiss QR-bill, TWINT, Swiss VAT
> (MWST/TVA/IVA) and de/fr/it/en built in. The logic runs inside your app as a TypeScript/JavaScript
> library, the data stays in your own database through adapters (Drizzle for
> Postgres; Prisma and Kysely planned). No hosted service in between.

Status: early, open source (MIT). subkit 0.2 (extracted from production
code) and shopkit 0.1 (preview) are on npm – the two kits we focus on. npm
scope: `@agentkit.ch` (not `@agentkit`, which belongs to someone else).

## Install

- `npm i @agentkit.ch/subkit` – subscriptions and invoices
- `npm i @agentkit.ch/shopkit` – shop
- ES modules with type declarations. Peer dependencies only for the entry
  points that use them: `drizzle-orm` (`/drizzle`), `react` (`/react`),
  `swissqrbill` (`/swiss-qr-bill`).
- Each package README lists every entry point and a five-minute setup:
  https://www.npmjs.com/package/@agentkit.ch/subkit,
  https://www.npmjs.com/package/@agentkit.ch/shopkit

## Kits

- subkit (`@agentkit.ch/subkit`, preview): subscriptions, plans, trials, proration,
  card or invoice billing, dunning, entitlements (`hasFeature`, `getLimit`),
  lifecycle emails, printable invoices, Swiss QR-bill, bank reconciliation
  (camt.053 / camt.054), React `<BillingPortal />`.
- shopkit (`@agentkit.ch/shopkit`, preview): products and variants (physical,
  digital, gift cards) with translations, stock reserved at checkout, cart for
  guests and signed-in customers, checkout online (TWINT, card) or on invoice
  with QR-bill, VAT per product rate, discount codes, gift cards (sold and
  redeemed), shipping rates (flat, weight tiers, free above, pickup), orders
  with fulfillment and partial refunds, order emails, receipts, storefront and
  back office APIs, React `<Cart />`, `<Checkout />`, `<OrderStatus />`,
  `<OrderHistory />`, `useCart()`. Config: `createShop({ database, provider,
  shipping: { rates }, tax })`; cron `runDue()` releases unpaid orders and
  sends payment reminders; invoice orders are booked from camt.053 / camt.054.
  Next: back office components – `<ShopAdmin />` from
  `@agentkit.ch/shopkit/react/admin` (orders, products and stock, discount
  codes, gift cards, bank import; your auth decides access through
  `createShopAdminHandler({ authorize })`) are in the repo and reach npm
  with the next release; Swiss Post labels and live tariffs, digital
  downloads.

## Test sites

Try the kits before installing them – they run in the browser with the same
engine, HTTP handler and React components, a simulated payment page and a
movable clock. A Config tab changes the kit's real options (prices, trial, VAT,
payment and shipping methods, dunning, theme) and shows the resulting code:
https://shop.agentkit.ch (shopkit), https://sub.agentkit.ch (subkit).

## Open source and cost

- MIT open source: https://github.com/siebenberge/agentkit, packages on npm.
  No licence fee and no per-transaction fee – only the payment provider
  (zahls.ch) charges its own fees.

## Language

- TypeScript, usable from JavaScript: `npm i @agentkit.ch/subkit`. Runs on
  Node.js, Bun, Deno and edge runtimes (fetch handlers).
- Other languages are not planned for now.

## Switzerland

agentkit is built for the Swiss market first.

- Swiss QR-bill (SIX implementation guidelines): QR-IBAN with 27-digit QR
  reference, or IBAN with RF creditor reference (ISO 11649). CHF and EUR.
  `@agentkit.ch/subkit/swiss-qr-bill`, peer dependency `swissqrbill`.
- Payments: zahls.ch with TWINT and credit cards. Other providers can be
  added through the `PaymentProvider` interface.
- VAT: `tax: { rateBps: 810, inclusive: true }` (8.1 % standard rate).
  Invoices show the VAT line and the seller's CHE number. shopkit: rate per
  product (8.1 / 2.6 / 3.8 %, `taxRateBps`), shipping split across the rates
  of the goods, gift cards sold without VAT, optional 5-Rappen rounding
  (`roundToFiveRappen`). Planned for subkit: per-line rates, 5-Rappen
  rounding.
- Languages: de, fr, it, en for UI, emails and invoices (`locale: 'de-CH'`).
- Bank reconciliation: `parseCamt(xml)` reads camt.053 / camt.054 (no
  dependency), `reconcileBankPayments({ payments, reference })` matches them
  by QR / creditor reference (or the invoice number in the message) and marks
  invoices / invoice orders paid; the rest is reported (underpaid, paid
  already, unmatched). `/camt` entry of both kits.
- Planned: reminder levels with fees, Swiss Post labels and live tariffs in
  shopkit.
- Data protection: the kits run in your app and store data in your
  database; no extra processor for customer data.

## Concepts

- One config in code: `createSubscriptions({ database, provider, plans,
  defaultPlanId, tax })` from `@agentkit.ch/subkit`, `createShop({ database,
  provider, shipping, tax })` from `@agentkit.ch/shopkit`. Adapters:
  `drizzleAdapter(db)` from `/drizzle` (Postgres, tables in `/drizzle/schema`),
  `memoryAdapter()` from `/memory` (tests, demos). Provider:
  `zahlsProvider({ instance, apiKey })` from `/zahls`.
- Planned: a shared `@agentkit.ch/core` and a CLI (`npx @agentkit.ch/cli
  init`) that writes the schema and the route.
- Storage adapter contract (`StorageAdapter`): create, findOne, findMany,
  update (atomic compare-and-set), optional transaction.
- HTTP: every kit exposes one handler for its self-service API and the
  payment webhook (fetch Request → Response): `createSubscriptionsHandler()`,
  `createShopHandler()` / `createShopAdminHandler()` from `/http`, plus
  `toNextJsHandler()`.
- Payments: `PaymentProvider` interface; zahls.ch (incl. TWINT) ships
  first. Card data never touches your server, only provider tokens.
- Money is always integer Rappen/cents. Swiss VAT via `tax: { rateBps: 810 }`.
- Customers are referenced by `externalId` – the id from your product
  (user, team, association).
- Cron: call `runDue()` every few minutes for renewals, retries and dunning
  (subkit) or expired orders and payment reminders (shopkit).

## Errors

Every error of the kits has a code and `docsUrl`, a link to the cause and
fix: `https://agentkit.ch/errors#<kit>-<CODE>` (e.g.
`#subkit-PLAN_NOT_FOUND`). HTTP error responses are
`{ "error": "<CODE>", "docs": "<link>" }`. The page is in de, fr, it and en.

## MCP

- Docs MCP for coding agents: `https://agentkit.ch/mcp` (Streamable HTTP, no
  key, read-only) – `search_docs`, `read_doc`, `list_docs`,
  `explain_error`. Claude Code:
  `claude mcp add --transport http agentkit https://agentkit.ch/mcp`.
- MCP in your app, for your team: `createSubscriptionsMcpHandler` from
  `@agentkit.ch/subkit/mcp` (find customers, billing, change plan, cancel,
  mark invoices paid, …) and `createShopMcpHandler` from
  `@agentkit.ch/shopkit/mcp` (orders, stock, discount codes, gift cards).
  Mounted as a POST route, your `authorize` on every request (`'read-only'`
  hides the tools that change data). Payment and guest-link tokens never
  reach the model.

## Website languages

The site exists in German (/de), French (/fr), Italian (/it) and English
(/en).
